question: What is the centered moving average of the customs duty rate imposed on goods subject to duty from FY1939 - 1941 inclusive rounded to the nearest thousandths place?
raw_response:
The rate computation: each year's customs duty rate (duties on dutiable goods / value of dutiable goods), then the centered 3-year moving average (centered on FY1940) = average of FY1939, FY1940, FY1941.

The rates are ~38.4%, ~37.9%, ~39.9%, giving a centered moving average of **38.757%**.

The question asks for a "rate" rounded to nearest thousandths. A rate expressed as a percent = 38.757. This is the natural interpretation (the values are ~38%, clearly a percentage rate of duty).

This is a MODE A answer (single decimal value) — no delimiter needed since it's a single number.

The centered moving average of the customs duty rate (FY1939: 38.432%, FY1940: 37.928%, FY1941: 39.912%) = (38.432 + 37.928 + 39.912)/3 = 38.757%.

<FINAL_ANSWER>38.757</FINAL_ANSWER>
